Lemma
[$L^p$ convergence of mollifications] 1. ch7:7.2\group ch07-sobolev-spaces Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0160, gilbarg-trudinger:page-0161 Let $1\leq p<\infty $. If $u\in L^p_{\mathrm{loc}}(\Omega )$, then $u_h\to u$ in $L^p_{\mathrm{loc}}(\Omega )$. If $u\in L^p(\Omega )$ is extended by zero, convergence holds in $L^p(\mathbb R^n)$. Moreover, for $\Omega '\Subset \Omega $ and $\Omega ''=\{ x:\dist (x,\Omega ')<h\} \Subset \Omega $, \begin{equation} \tag {7.15} \| u_h\| _{L^p(\Omega ')}\leq \| u\| _{L^p(\Omega '')}. \end{equation}
Proof

\sketch Jensen’s inequality and Fubini give (7.15). Approximate $u$ on a slightly larger subdomain by a continuous function, apply Lemma 7.1 to that function, and use (7.15) on the approximation error. The global claim follows after zero extension.

□
